cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Take half Mum's care-home forms. Being her children can't mean I'm the paperwork child.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then sit beside me. I'll explain, and you can write.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. It asks for one main contact.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yourself. I'll help with every answer, but Mum needs to know she can reach either of us.

mechanism: A uses form-filling expertise to make a sibling share parental-care responsibility rather than delegate it all to the more competent child.
confusable: D73 asks help as proof of connection; D77 specifically shares an existing burden as part of relationship obligations.
comparison: Letters alternative shares emotional decisions after a relationship; care forms alternative uses a real contact field to redistribute family work.
seedUse: Mum care forms, unequal expertise and main-contact field derive from D77-a; S03 adds field sequence and contact-role correction.
